payload.comment: Training stage is internally consistent and correctly executed. Key verifications: (1) train_config matches best_configuration.train_config exactly (same hash f770eaa3…, same hyperparameters). (2) Early-stopping logic is correct: best epoch 11, patience 3 → stop after epoch 14 (14 epochs completed, 15 planned). (3) Cosine LR schedule values are numerically consistent with lr_max=0.001 over 15 epochs (epoch 1: 9.89e-4, epoch 14: 1.09e-5). (4) Validation accuracy progression is smooth and monotone-improving after epoch 3, with minor dips at epochs 7 and 10 — no anomalies. (5) Test metrics remain locked (test_locked=true, test_metrics_used=false); no leakage. (6) Augmented train size 359,984 = 89,996 × 4 (identity + hflip + vflip + rotate90) is arithmetically correct. (7) train_stats_only=true ensures normalization statistics are computed from training data only. (8) The large gap between search-trial val_acc (0.9827, 2 epochs) and final val_acc (0.9972, 14 epochs) is expected: the search used search_epochs=2 as a quick filter, while the final run used the full 15-epoch budget with a longer cosine schedule. Minor observations (non-blocking): rationale strings in train_config and best_configuration are truncated with '…', reducing full auditability of the design justification; early_stopping_patience was raised from 1 (search) to 3 (final) without an explicit note in the rationale — this is a reasonable escalation for the longer run but would benefit from a one-line justification. Neither issue affects correctness or reproducibility. No deterministic findings were raised. Proceed to the next stage.
